articles.title: World Drowning Prevention Day — 25 July
articles.title_hi: विश्व डूबने से बचाव दिवस — 25 जुलाई
articles.summary: World Drowning Prevention Day (25 July) is a UN observance highlighting drowning as a preventable public health challenge.
articles.summary_hi: विश्व डूबने से बचाव दिवस (25 जुलाई) डूबने को रोके जा सकने वाली सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य चुनौती बताता है।
articles.content:
World Drowning Prevention Day is observed on 25 July, designated by the UN General Assembly. Drowning is a major cause of unintentional injury deaths worldwide, especially among children.

WHO promotes swim skills, supervision, barriers, and flood preparedness. In India, monsoon and flood seasons raise drowning risks — linking the day to disaster awareness.

For IB ACIO: date (25 July), UN day, WHO prevention focus.
articles.content_hi:
25 जुलाई — UN दिवस। WHO बचाव रणनीति। मानसून/बाढ़ में भारत में जोखिम।

IB ACIO: 25 July — याद रखें।
articles.question: World Drowning Prevention Day is observed on:
articles.question_hi: विश्व डूबने से बचाव दिवस कब मनाया जाता है?
articles.explanation: It is observed annually on 25 July as a UN day.
articles.explanation_hi: यह हर वर्ष 25 जुलाई को UN दिवस के रूप में मनाया जाता है।
articles.moreInfo: Related: NDMA disaster framework in next article.

articles.title: NDMA — National Disaster Management Authority
articles.summary: NDMA is India’s apex disaster management body under the DM Act 2005, chaired by the Prime Minister.
articles.summary_hi: NDMA आपदा प्रबंधन अधिनियम 2005 के तहत शीर्ष निकाय, प्रधानमंत्री अध्यक्ष।
articles.content:
NDMA was constituted under the Disaster Management Act, 2005. The Prime Minister is Chairperson. SDMAs are headed by Chief Ministers. NDRF is the specialised response force.

India’s approach emphasises prevention, mitigation, and preparedness — not only post-disaster relief.

For IB ACIO: DM Act 2005, PM Chairperson, NDRF.
articles.content_hi:
NDMA: 2005, PM अध्यक्ष। SDMA: CM। NDRF प्रतिक्रिया बल।

IB ACIO: 2005, PM — याद रखें।
articles.question: Who chairs the NDMA?
articles.question_hi: NDMA की अध्यक्षता कौन करता है?
articles.explanation: The Prime Minister is the Chairperson of NDMA.
articles.explanation_hi: प्रधानमंत्री NDMA के अध्यक्ष होते हैं।
articles.moreInfo_hi: संबंधित: आज का drowning prevention दिवस।

articles.title: PM SVANidhi — Loans for Street Vendors
articles.title_hi: पीएम स्वनिधि — स्ट्रीट वेंडर्स के लिए ऋण
articles.summary: PM SVANidhi provides affordable working-capital loans to street vendors under MoHUA.
articles.summary_hi: पीएम स्वनिधि स्ट्रीट वेंडर्स को किफायती कार्यशील पूंजी ऋण — MoHUA।
articles.content:
PM Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) supports street vendors with collateral-free working capital loans and incentives for timely repayment and digital payments.

Implemented by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, it aids livelihood recovery and formalisation of urban informal workers.

For IB ACIO: MoHUA, street vendors, collateral-free loans.
articles.content_hi:
PM SVANidhi: आवास एवं शहरी कार्य मंत्रालय। बिना गारंटी ऋण।

IB ACIO: MoHUA — याद रखें।
articles.question: PM SVANidhi is implemented by which Ministry?
articles.question_hi: पीएम स्वनिधि किस मंत्रालय द्वारा लागू होती है?
options: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
articles.explanation: PM SVANidhi is under the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.
articles.explanation_hi: पीएम स्वनिधि आवास एवं शहरी कार्य मंत्रालय के तहत है।
articles.moreInfo: Earlier editions also noted SVANidhi beneficiary milestones.
articles.moreInfo_hi: पहले संस्करणों में भी स्वनिधि कवर।

articles.title: Repo Corridor — LAF and Liquidity Management
articles.title_hi: रेपो कॉरिडोर — LAF और तरलता प्रबंधन
articles.summary: RBI manages liquidity through the Liquidity Adjustment Facility using repo, reverse repo/SDF, and related tools.
articles.summary_hi: RBI तरलता समायोजन सुविधा के जरिए repo, reverse repo/SDF आदि से तरलता प्रबंधित करता है।
articles.content:
The Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF) is RBI’s framework to inject or absorb liquidity. Repo injects liquidity; reverse repo/Standing Deposit Facility absorbs surplus.

These tools work with CRR/SLR and are guided by MPC’s policy rate decisions. Understanding the liquidity corridor is core banking GK.

For IB ACIO: LAF, repo (inject), reverse repo/SDF (absorb).
articles.content_hi:
LAF: तरलता समायोजन। Repo = इंजेक्शन; Reverse repo/SDF = अवशोषण।

IB ACIO: LAF basics — याद रखें।
articles.question: Which tool typically injects liquidity into the banking system?
articles.question_hi: कौन सा उपकरण सामान्यतः बैंकिंग प्रणाली में तरलता डालता है?
articles.explanation: Repo operations inject liquidity by lending to banks against securities.
articles.explanation_hi: Repo परिचालन प्रतिभूतियों के बदले बैंकों को उधार देकर तरलता डालता है।
articles.moreInfo: Related: Repo vs Reverse Repo (20 July), CRR/SLR (22 July).

articles.title: Border Security Force (BSF) — India’s Border Guarding Force
articles.title_hi: सीमा सुरक्षा बल (BSF) — भारत का सीमा रक्षक बल
articles.summary: BSF is India’s primary border guarding force for Pakistan and Bangladesh borders, under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
articles.summary_hi: BSF पाकिस्तान और बांग्लादेश सीमाओं का प्रमुख रक्षक बल — गृह मंत्रालय।
articles.content:
The Border Security Force was raised in 1965 after the India–Pakistan war. It guards India’s borders with Pakistan and Bangladesh and is the world’s largest border guarding force.

BSF functions under the Ministry of Home Affairs as a Central Armed Police Force (CAPF). Other CAPFs include CRPF, ITBP, SSB, CISF, and Assam Rifles (special status).

For IB ACIO: raised 1965, Pak/Bangladesh borders, MHA/CAPF.
articles.content_hi:
BSF 1965। पाक व बांग्लादेश सीमा। गृह मंत्रालय, CAPF।

IB ACIO: 1965, MHA — याद रखें।
articles.question: BSF was raised in which year?
articles.moreInfo: Upcoming: CRPF Foundation Day on 27 July.

articles.title: Gaganyaan — Human Spaceflight Programme Update Focus
articles.summary: Gaganyaan aims to send Indian astronauts (Vyomanauts) to Low Earth Orbit using LVM3 — ISRO’s first human spaceflight mission.
articles.summary_hi: गगनयान LVM3 से भारतीय अंतरिक्ष यात्रियों को LEO में भेजने का लक्ष्य — ISRO का प्रथम मानव मिशन।
articles.content:
Gaganyaan is ISRO’s human spaceflight programme to demonstrate crewed LEO capability. LVM3 is the designated launch vehicle. Crew module and escape systems are critical technologies.

Astronaut training has involved international cooperation. Success would place India among nations with independent human spaceflight capability.

For IB ACIO: ISRO, LVM3 launcher, LEO human mission.
articles.content_hi:
गगनयान: ISRO, LVM3, LEO। Vyomanaut शब्द प्रचलित।

IB ACIO: Gaganyaan, LVM3 — याद रखें।
articles.question: Which launch vehicle is designated for Gaganyaan?
articles.question_hi: गगनयान के लिए कौन सा प्रक्षेपण यान निर्धारित है?
articles.explanation: Gaganyaan is planned on ISRO’s LVM3 launcher.
articles.explanation_hi: गगनयान ISRO के LVM3 प्रक्षेपण यान पर नियोजित है।

articles.title: UN Security Council — Structure and India’s Bid
articles.title_hi: UN सुरक्षा परिषद — संरचना और भारत की दावेदारी
articles.summary: UNSC has 5 permanent members with veto and 10 non-permanent members. India seeks permanent membership via G4.
articles.summary_hi: UNSC में 5 स्थायी सदस्य (वीटो) और 10 अस्थायी। भारत G4 के जरिए स्थायी सदस्यता चाहता है।
articles.content:
The UN Security Council has 15 members: P5 (China, France, Russia, UK, USA) with veto, and 10 non-permanent members elected for two-year terms.

India has been a non-permanent member multiple times and campaigns for permanent seat through the G4 (India, Germany, Japan, Brazil), citing population, democracy, and peacekeeping contributions.

For IB ACIO: P5+veto, 10 non-permanent, G4 reform agenda.
articles.content_hi:
UNSC: 15 सदस्य, P5 वीटो। G4: India, Germany, Japan, Brazil।

IB ACIO: P5, G4 — याद रखें।
articles.question: How many permanent members does the UN Security Council have?
articles.question_hi: UN सुरक्षा परिषद के कितने स्थायी सदस्य हैं?
articles.explanation: There are five permanent members (P5) with veto power.
articles.explanation_hi: वीटो शक्ति वाले पांच स्थायी सदस्य (P5) हैं।

articles.title: Mangrove Ecosystems — Coastal Shields (Preview 26 July)
articles.title_hi: मैंग्रोव पारिस्थितिकी — तटीय ढाल (26 जुलाई पूर्वावलोकन)
articles.summary: Mangroves protect coasts from storms and erosion. UNESCO marks International Day for Conservation of Mangrove Ecosystem on 26 July.
articles.summary_hi: मैंग्रोव तूफान और कटाव से तट बचाते हैं। UNESCO 26 जुलाई को मैंग्रोव संरक्षण दिवस मनाता है।
articles.content:
Mangroves are salt-tolerant coastal forests that act as bioshields against cyclones, tsunamis, and erosion, and support fisheries and carbon storage.

India’s major mangrove areas include the Sundarbans (West Bengal), Bhitarkanika (Odisha), and coastal Gujarat/Andaman regions. Sundarbans is also a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

International Day for the Conservation of the Mangrove Ecosystem is observed on 26 July (UNESCO).

For IB ACIO: 26 July mangrove day, Sundarbans, bioshield role.
articles.content_hi:
मैंग्रोव: तटीय सुरक्षा, मत्स्य, कार्बन। सुंदरबन प्रसिद्ध।

26 जुलाई — UNESCO मैंग्रोव दिवस।

IB ACIO: 26 July, Sundarbans — याद रखें।
articles.question: International Day for Conservation of Mangrove Ecosystem is on:
articles.question_hi: मैंग्रोव पारिस्थितिकी संरक्षण अंतर्राष्ट्रीय दिवस कब है?
articles.explanation: UNESCO observes the mangrove conservation day on 26 July.
articles.explanation_hi: UNESCO 26 जुलाई को मैंग्रोव संरक्षण दिवस मनाता है।

articles.title: Governor of a State — Constitutional Position
articles.summary: The Governor is the constitutional head of a state, appointed by the President for a term of five years (Article 153 onwards).
articles.summary_hi: राज्यपाल राज्य के संवैधानिक अध्यक्ष, राष्ट्रपति द्वारा 5 वर्ष के लिए नियुक्त (धारा 153 से)।
articles.content:
Article 153 provides for a Governor for each state. Appointed by the President, the Governor holds office during the pleasure of the President; normal term is five years.

Key powers: assent to bills, ordinance (Art. 213), recommending President’s Rule (Art. 356), and discretionary powers in limited situations. Nominates members to Legislative Council where applicable.

For IB ACIO: appointed by President, 5-year term, Articles 153/213/356 links.
articles.content_hi:
धारा 153 — राज्यपाल। राष्ट्रपति नियुक्त, 5 वर्ष। अध्यादेश 213।

IB ACIO: President appoints — याद रखें।
articles.question: Who appoints the Governor of a state in India?
articles.question_hi: भारत में राज्य के राज्यपाल की नियुक्ति कौन करता है?
articles.explanation: The Governor is appointed by the President of India.
articles.explanation_hi: राज्यपाल की नियुक्ति भारत के राष्ट्रपति करते हैं।

articles.title: FIFA — World Football Governing Body
articles.summary: FIFA governs world football, headquartered in Zurich; organises the FIFA World Cup every four years.
articles.summary_hi: फीफा विश्व फुटबॉल का शासी निकाय, मुख्यालय ज्यूरिख — हर चार वर्ष विश्व कप।
articles.content:
FIFA (Fédération Internationale de Football Association) is the international governing body of football. Headquarters: Zurich, Switzerland.

It organises the FIFA World Cup (men’s and women’s). Qatar hosted 2022; 2026 will be co-hosted by USA, Canada, and Mexico.

For IB ACIO: HQ Zurich, World Cup cycle, 2026 hosts.
articles.content_hi:
FIFA HQ: Zurich। WC 2022 Qatar; 2026 USA-Canada-Mexico।

IB ACIO: Zurich, 2026 hosts — याद रखें।
articles.question: Where is FIFA headquartered?
articles.explanation: FIFA headquarters is in Zurich, Switzerland.
articles.explanation_hi: FIFA का मुख्यालय ज्यूरिख, स्विट्ज़रलैंड में है।
